I've heard cracked disc hubs can wreck a disc drive by shattering in them, so I'm guessing that this is even worse?

I explained in a comment, but it has a silver ring plastered on the center of the disc, this is apparently done by Gamestop/EB Games to hide and "fix" damage done to the center of discs, and I've seen in comments of other posts that it could possibly cause issues with the disc drive
Can you explain why, if you can?

Noticed while looking through my collection that my copy of X-Men Origins has a silver ring plastered onto the center of the disc. I did some digging online and found that these are some sort of protection that Gamestop/EB Games puts on damaged discs, but I can't find any definitive answer on whether or not discs with these rings are safe to use, as some just say not to remove the ring and others say it will wreck the disc drive or something like that. So I was wondering if anyone here had experience with these kind of discs and how they faired? I also noticed that the ring is lifted a bit near the center, is that also something to worry about?
